text:
jordan: Planning APAC maintenance (apac-west1) TOMORROW 23:00-01:00 UTC. Target: NIC microcode + nvlink driver bump on GPU racks. We'll do a staggered rack reboot in 4 cohorts to limit capacity loss. Expected per-cohort drain ~45-75m, total window ~2h.

maya: Can you list exact pools and any denied pools?

jordan: In-scope: tag:apac-gpu-general, apac-gpu-spot-burst. Out-of-scope: tag:tenant-priority, dedicated-reserved. Notified tenants: retail-x, health-y.

li: Runbook + drain commands? Need to hand to oncall.

jordan: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/apac-nic-nvlink. Drain snippet: ```kubectl cordon <node> && kubectl drain <node> --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120``` Wait for evictions then reboot.

sam: We'll canary two nodes first (gpu-node-201/202). Plan: reboot canary -> wait 10m -> manual kv-seed -> smoke. Autoscripts will kick an automated seed at ~15m.

maya: Add rollout guard: auto-pause + rollback if p95 latency >2x baseline for 5m. Also reduce trace sampling to 5% for apac during window.

ton y: Finance: will cross-region fallback cause notable egress? Estimate please.

jordan: Estimated egress bump ~2% for the window (fallback to us-west/eu pools). Finance pre-approved. See ops cost doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/maint-costs/apac-mar2026.

infra-bot: scheduled-maintenance-bot: Ticket MNT-7899 created. Cohorts: a,b,c,d. Canaries: gpu-node-201,gpu-node-202.

li: I'll post a console banner 2h before and send customer notices for medium+ risk tenants. Draft notice: "Planned APAC maintenance tonight; brief latency increases possible for some hosted requests. No data loss expected."

sam: Monitoring checklist posted in runbook. During window watch p50/p95, queue depth, dispatch failures. Post window check KV hit-rate and cold-start ratio.

maya: I'll own canary execution. If any anomaly, trigger rollback immediately and notify customer-ops. I'll post a post-maint cost/impact summary within 24h.

infra-bot: scheduled-maintenance-bot: Scheduled start 23:00 UTC. End estimated 01:00 UTC.
